required_stored_conditions: strict forward DAG and nonnegative unit flow
exact original homogeneous net-P PCS16 and connected C/D/Q bounds
exact stored d>=c>=0 and exact lambda>=0
all96slot control energy including outside-window rebound
proof_steps: Subtract common=min(C,D): netP/Q unchanged; priced objective rises by lambda*(d-c)*common.
For stayflowa>0 normalize cancelled controls by a. They lie in one exact integer-mode PCS half-polygon. For a=0 connected bounds force zero controls.
Independent nonnegative local row combinations bound every normalized branch; hence per-stay priced term<=a*h.
Exact Bellman inequalities bound each arc by potential drop; multiply by nonnegative fractional flow and telescope to source potential.
Original SOC equations sum to E=initial-terminal; add lambda*E to recover R<=sourcePotential+lambda*(initial-terminal).
general_theorem.implication: This proves the candidate for every existing fractional LP point; it cannot remove LP points or improve the LP bound.
